full_page.content:
1946, November 14
The following is a faithful transcription of a photo copy of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
Wm Holdsworth - Ward 14 Grace Hospital Detroit, Michigan.
Nov. 14th, 1946
"0 all ye works of the Lord! Praise the Lord .... "
God bless you Wm Hol's. Glad to know you are still on "the job - trying to make the grade to a happy eternity - some grade too .. not ? - now and then especially -
Best regards to Mr. Schaffrtein ...
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
I have enrolled for speedy recovery, God willing.
1937, April 18
(Handwritten message added to a Seraphic Mass Association Card, by Fr. Solanus.)
William Holdsworth - for speedy recovery, God willing April 18, 1937
God bless you William -- But? Come, Shake off that excessive worry. God is watching all. He knows best
Fr. Solanus O.M.Cap.
Original in possession of: Mrs. Arthur (Georgia) Gietzen 22237 Virginia St. E. Detroit, Mich. 48021
